login.title: Sign in
login.failed: Sign-in failed — check the username and password
login.issued: Accounts are issued by the hospital administrator.
login.help: Ask the administrator to reset it. Never sign in on somebody else's name — every act at a counter is recorded against the person who did it.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.why: If an administrator issued this password, you must choose your own before you can use the system.
changePassword.rule: At least 10 characters. No upper-case or symbol rules — length is what matters. It must not be your username.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match

mobile.policy: The new password does not meet the rule above
mobile.network: The server could not be reached. Check the phone’s internet and try again.
mobile.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
mobile.seatHint: Only the screens your role allows are shown.
mobile.none: Your account has no phone screens yet. Ask the administrator.
mobile.unlockFailed: Not confirmed. Tap Unlock to try again.

vitals.scanHint: Hold the code inside the frame. It reads by itself.
vitals.scanAsk: The camera is needed to scan a patient card.
vitals.scanDenied: The camera is switched off for HMIS. Allow it in the phone’s settings, or type the token number.
vitals.stale: No connection — the bench is shown as of {{time}}
vitals.saveNetwork: Not saved — the server could not be reached. Nothing was sent. Check the internet and press Save again.
vitals.alreadyCharted: Vitals are already saved for this visit. To correct a saved chart, use the vitals bay on a computer for now.
vitals.requiredLegend: * needed before this chart can be saved
vitals.tapToTake: Tap a patient to take them

identify.notOnBench: {{who}} is not on this bench — check the slip, or send them to the front desk
identify.unknownPatient: This row has no patient record the bay can read
identify.scanUnavailable: The scanner check is unavailable — type the token number instead

scanFailed.malformed: That scan is not a patient card
scanFailed.invalid_signature: That card did not verify — a copied or edited code

scanFailed.unknown_patient: That card belongs to no patient on file

identify.saving: A save is still on its way — wait for the ✓ before taking the next person

miss.token: Token {{token}} is not on today's bench — check the slip, or send them to the front desk
miss.uhid: {{uhid}} is not on today's bench — check the slip, or send them to the front desk
miss.prescription: That prescription's visit is not on today's bench — send them to the front desk
miss.ambiguous: Token {{token}} is on the bench for {{count}} doctors — type it as the slip prints it, like {{example}}, or pick the patient from the bench
miss.ambiguousPlain: Token {{token}} is on the bench for {{count}} doctors — pick the patient from the bench

visit.plain: Visit {{visitNo}} is not on today's bench — check the slip, or send them to the front desk
visit.unknown_visit: No visit has the number {{visitNo}} — check it against the slip
visit.other_day: Visit {{visitNo}} is from {{date}}, not today — send them to the front desk for today's visit
visit.abandoned: Visit {{visitNo}} was withdrawn at the front desk — send them back there
visit.completed: Visit {{visitNo}} is already finished — the consultation is done
visit.not_queued: Visit {{visitNo}} is not in any doctor's queue — send them to the front desk

valve.why: this bench is the doctors' wait time

bench.title: The bench
bench.failed: The bench could not be read — the list may be stale
bench.valveNote: The valve: every minute a patient waits here is a minute a doctor waits downstream.

allergy.title: Allergies
allergy.none: Nothing on file — ask the patient

session.empty: Nobody in hand — scan, or type a token number or UHID
session.carry: Carried forward, locked until a reason: {{vitals}}
session.noHistory: No history to show for this visit
session.sealed: Confidential record — the band is known, the history is sealed at this desk
session.title: On the stool
session.dignity: This screen faces you. The patient display shows a token and a direction — never a weight, never a number.

capture.carriedLocked: carried forward — locked until a reason
capture.bpBoth: BP needs both numbers — type 150-90 or 150/90
capture.bpOrder: The top number is the bigger one — type it as 150-90
capture.deviceSilent: No reading from the device — type it
capture.feeGate: Not billed yet — the counter has not taken this visit's fee. Bill it at the counter, or press “Save & send NOW (emergency)” if this cannot wait.

tint.notice: outside band — the doctor is told ahead of the call
tint.sam: SAM — severe; its own emergency lane

capture.rrNudge: RR {{value}} in under fifteen seconds? Charted — but count it:
capture.rrCounted: fifteen seconds done — type the count
capture.weightQuiet: 🔇 never said aloud — it's on the slip

gate.slippedDigit: {{value}} kg on an adult — a slipped digit becomes a chart fact in one keystroke
gate.shrinkingAdult: height {{value}} against {{last}} — re-measure once before it becomes true
gate.probeError: SpO₂ read {{value}}% — held OUT of the chart. A talking patient at {{value}}% is a probe problem until proven otherwise; re-clip and take it again
gate.confirmProbe: It is real — the patient IS that low. Chart it and send

unlock.label: Reason to re-measure
unlock.serverLocked: The server holds this value locked — pick a reason to change it
unlock.was: old value kept beside the new one: {{value}}

saved.title: Saved {{who}} — sent to {{doctor}}'s board
saved.feeWaived: Saved without a bill — emergency. The fee is still due: the counter and the doctor are both shown this.
saved.notice: Told the doctor ahead of the call: {{vitals}}

protocol.otherArm: Danger reading — the OTHER ARM, now. Rest is refused at danger numbers.
protocol.calmed: The other arm is inside the band — both readings go to the doctor as a pair, the board does not move.
protocol.escalated: Went NOW as class 0 (was class {{from}}) — {{doctor}}'s screen flashed. Do not send them alone.
protocol.committed: cancel window closed — class 0 stands. Reversing now is a supervisor action, not a keystroke.
protocol.cancelled: Cancelled — back to class {{from}}. The chart keeps the reading.
protocol.again: Danger reading — take it AGAIN, now, before anything else. Rest is refused at danger numbers.
protocol.rerunAsk: A cancelled bump is not re-run by the agent. This reading is danger again —

rest.offer: Elevated, not dangerous — {{minutes}} minutes on the rest chairs, no chai, no phone-pacing. Recall at {{time}}; the first reading is held.
rest.sent: To the rest chairs: {{who}} — recall at {{time}}. The desk is clear.
rest.heldFirst: First reading held from the bench: {{value}} — take the second, both go as a pair.

unpaid.title: This patient has not paid the consultation fee yet.

opdConsult.allergyUnknown: Saved as written — the prescription check knows no rule for this, so it will not warn on it.
